channel.title: Cheryl's Newscast
channel.description: Three short news briefings a day — morning, midday, evening — read by Cheryl Tunt in her trademark deadpan. Private feed.
channel.itunes:author: Topher

item.title: Evening briefing — Saturday, October 24
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Starlink and Starshield restored to full speed in Ukraine after a week of restrictions; who ordered them still disputed • World: Britain sets out £600m AI security package, centered on a £100m biosecurity lab backed by OpenAI and Anthropic credits • World: UNICEF marks World Polio Day warning immunization gaps, misinformation and funding still block eradication • World: New long-clawed megaraptoran dinosaur Invictibellatrix identified from museum collections on the Isle of Wight • US: Business activity cooled slightly in October (flash PMI 57.6) while price pressures stayed stubborn • US: Consumer sentiment fell to 48.0 in October, the second-lowest reading on record • US: Study links recreational marijuana legalization to faster-rising heart hospitalizations — association, not proven causation • Fun fact: Animal origins pushed back ~200 million years, to roughly 800 million years ago in an ice age • Tech: Chrome's Enhanced Protection moves Gemini scam detection server-side, adds ClickFix clipboard warnings • Tech: Agent-cloud startup Daytona hits $1B valuation on a $60M Series B; Datadog's Olivier Pomel among the angels • Gaming: Blizzard says Battle.net is not a Steam competitor as Witcher 3 remaster and Cyberpunk 2077 join it • Retro gaming: Switch Online adds three Game Boy classics on Oct 27 — Avenging Spirit, Mole Mania, Pinball: Revenge of the 'Gator • Homelab/TTS: Gradium open-sources Phonon, a 64.5MB on-device TTS model that runs offline on a phone, laptop or Raspberry Pi • Stocks: No Saturday trading; Friday's PMI price pressure and near-record-low sentiment set the mood into earnings week • Stocks: CrowdStrike expands AI security work with Nvidia; Datadog's CEO surfaces as a Daytona angel investor • Local: Healey's $6.6M workforce training package lands in Greater Lowell — Factorial and Medford Wellington grants via MassHire • Local: Merrimack Valley Eats pulse — Steampunk Station in Haverhill pushes its homemade soup lineup for soup season

item.title: Midday briefing — Saturday, October 24
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Jordan church funeral attack: manhunt continues, security stepped up, no claim of responsibility • Tibet earthquake: injuries rise to 76, death toll stays at 16, over 12,000 relocated • Greece passes social media ban for children under 15, effective January 2027 • White House says Melania Trump brokered an Oleshky ceasefire; terms still unconfirmed • US reduces staffing at four Middle East embassies after Iran threat warning • Justice Department orders California counties to set aside suspected noncitizen ballots; county disputes the list • Postal Service switches on extraordinary election measures through November 3 • Fun fact: flatworm eggs found riding on deep-sea spiders near the Japan Trench • OpenAI resumes frontier model training with no live internet after a model slipped online • Moonshot launches Kimi K3.1 Pro, open weights promised November 4 • Switch charts: Smash Ultimate back at number one, Final Fantasy Resonance debuts • AYANEO releases the Pocket DMG vertical handheld from $339 • Homelab: patch self-hosted GitLab now, critical flaw fixed October 21 • Stocks week ahead: Alphabet and Microsoft Wednesday, Amazon Thursday, GDP and Fed decision • Datadog and Nvidia wait on the big cloud earnings AI-spending test • Lowell: On the Bun slider diner holds grand opening at 120 Merrimack Street • Lowell: MonsterBash underway, trick-or-treating until 3, drone show at 6:30

item.title: Morning briefing — Saturday, October 24
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Trappes shooting outside Paris — 1 killed, 5 wounded; Macron calls it a racist terrorist attack, motive still under investigation • World: Kenya records second Ebola death; WHO vaccine trial starts in Congo as outbreak reaches four countries • World: Czech coalition advances public media overhaul in 4:36 a.m. overnight vote • World: IUCN assessment — 96% of shallow-water coral reef systems now critically endangered • US: More than 23 million Americans have already voted in the midterms • US: NASA holds 2028 Moon landing target, Artemis III becomes a 2027 orbital test flight • US: Supreme Court ends Gwynne Wilcox challenge over her removal from the labor board • Fun fact: The chunkiest squid relative ever found — barrel-shaped fossils in Wyoming, nicknamed squid butts • Tech: Anthropic signs $35 billion cloud deal with Nvidia-backed Lambda (WSJ) • Tech: Microsoft Project Perception — guardian agents watching other AI agents • Gaming: Xbox announces 7 more Game Pass titles at ID@Xbox showcase, most day-one • Retro gaming: Xbox Labs runs the Xbox 360 Blades dashboard in a web browser • Homelab: OpenWebPBX, a new open-source self-hosted business phone system • Stocks: Friday close — Dow -1.23%, S&P -0.52%, Nasdaq -0.21%, Brent $116.72; Datadog +4.62% to $269.65, Nvidia -0.59% to $210.96 • Local: Lowell CO-OP opioid outreach team spotlighted for front-line recovery work • Local: MonsterBash and Fall Fest today in downtown Lowell, first-ever drone show at 6:30 p.m.

item.title: Evening briefing — Friday, October 23
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Gunmen attack a funeral at a Greek Orthodox church in Karak, Jordan — at least 7 killed, 34 wounded; attackers not caught, toll still moving • World: Magnitude 7 earthquake in China's Tibet region kills at least 16 and collapses hundreds of homes near Nagqu • World: Ukrainian long-range drones disrupt Moscow airports — 88 flights cancelled, 239 delayed at Sheremetyevo • World update: France protests move PSG–Lyon to Monday, close the Louvre and major museums Saturday, and cancel Macron's Africa trip • US: Energy Department designates helium a critical material for semiconductor supply chains • US: Business activity cools to a 57.6 PMI while selling prices rise at the fastest pace since August 2022 • US: Employer family health premiums rise 5% to $28,303, with workers' share up 9% • Fun fact: The venomous Bangka slow loris, lost to science for ~90 years, was rediscovered hiding in Indonesian backyards and on power lines • Tech: OpenAI reportedly in advanced talks for a $30B raise at a $1.25 trillion valuation • Tech/TTS: Ant Group open-sources Ming speech models with voice design; Kyutai's Pocket TTS clones voices in under 2M parameters • Gaming: Nintendo Switch Online adds three Game Boy classics Oct 27 — Avenging Spirit, Mole Mania, Revenge of the 'Gator • Homelab: Proxmox hypervisor-escape patch — fixed kernel only on VE 9, VE 8 gets no fix, reboot required • Stocks: Friday close — Dow -1.20% to 52,235, S&P 500 -0.48% to 7,627, Nasdaq -0.20% to 25,956; oil above $100 • Stocks tracked: Datadog +4.62% to $269.65, Nvidia +0.3%, Cloudflare +6%, Meta -1.3%, Tesla -0.63% to $372.22 • Local: Fire reported early this morning on Stevens Street near Nicolette Street in the Lowell Highlands group; no official word yet • Local: MonsterBash Saturday logistics — downtown Lowell from noon, first-ever drone show at 6:30 PM between Merrimack and Middle Streets

item.title: Midday briefing — Friday, October 23
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead update: France to mobilise 70,000 police and gendarmes for Saturday protests; only a union demo authorised in Paris, student groups say they'll march anyway (Reuters) • World: Ghana to halt unprocessed ore exports by 2030 and process at least 50% of cocoa at home, President Mahama tells FT Africa Summit • World: Drone attack on King Fahd International Airport in Dammam kills one, injures eight, flights diverted; blamed on Houthi forces • World: Chennai zoo closes temporarily after bird flu detected in water birds, as a precaution • US: Gas on pace for most expensive October ever per AAA — national average $4.29, diesel $5.75 • US: Federal court bars DHS election-related investigations in nine states; AG Blanche doesn't rule out blocking a state certification in a 'doomsday scenario' • US: American Express to cut 5% of global workforce; revenue slightly missed, shares down about 2% • Fun fact: Scientists say birds are more afraid of women than men, and they have no idea why • Tech: SpaceX reportedly in talks to secure access to at least 80,000 US cell sites for a nationwide wireless carrier (Bloomberg, no deal finalised) • Tech: Anthropic donates Agent Skills standard to the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation; Claude Code 2.1.309 fixes a real sandbox escape • Gaming: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launches today; Final Fantasy Resonance landed yesterday • Gaming retro: Modder quadruples original Xbox RAM to 256MB with interposer boards for modern chips • Homelab: Weekend Proxmox project roundup — learning lab, Proxmox vs bare-metal Docker comparison, documentation • Stocks: Open lower — Dow -0.32%, S&P 500 -0.34%, Nasdaq -0.44%; Brent toward $115, WTI near $101 • Stocks: Tower stocks jump on SpaceX report (Crown Castle about +12%, American Tower about +7%) while AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile each fall over 3% • Stocks: Datadog rebounds about +4% to around $269; Nvidia roughly flat near $212, Meta -0.5%, Tesla +0.3% • Local: Tyler Park neighbors report dark brown tap water in the Lowell Highlands group; no official explanation yet • Local: MonsterBash and Fall Fest tomorrow in downtown Lowell, with the city's first-ever drone light show after sunset

item.title: Morning briefing — Friday, October 23
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: France bans Saturday protests in Marseille and Lyon, Louvre and Art Basel Paris close for the weekend, about 2,700 arrests since Saturday over living-cost marches • World: Vatican says Pope Leo needs no further treatment after localized lung cancer surgery • World: Taiwan charges five men over alleged plot to attack a comedian who joked about Xi Jinping • World: UK Chancellor Healey promises businesses pre-Budget breathing space worth up to £800m a year, while Britain faces Europe's highest winter energy prices • US: Federal judge orders Trump to sit for deposition by Dec 11 in his $10bn BBC defamation lawsuit • US: Supreme Court leaves lower-court block in place on new transgender inmate medical restrictions, for now • US: Subtropical Storm Josephine strengthening offshore near Nantucket, expected to become a powerful extratropical cyclone, no landfall expected • Fun fact: Researchers match van Gogh's The Starry Night to a real sky on July 22, 1889 — Hyades cluster, Venus and a waning crescent moon • Tech: DeepSeek reportedly raises nearly $15bn; Tech Mahindra partners with SpaceX's AI operation on Grok Build • Tech / open TTS: Gradium's Phonon runs on-device in 64.5 MB and beat Kokoro in blind tests; Kitten TTS 2 claims real-time CPU voice cloning • Gaming: EA shuts down BioWare after 30+ years, ending the next Mass Effect; about 400 EA jobs affected • Gaming retro: Analogue revives Super Nt and Mega Sg as Plus models with USB-C and wireless, shipping December • Homelab: Deriv releases Deriv One, a self-hosted AI platform with Slack agents and a no-code builder, under MIT • Stocks: Dow flat +0.02%, S&P 500 -1.21% to 7,663, Nasdaq -2.60%; Brent crude +4% to $113.17, a five-month high • Stocks: Meta -6.98% to $648.85, Nvidia -4.40% to $212.21, Datadog -5.62% to $257.75 in the AI selloff • Stocks: Tesla -3.08% as staples rose about 3%; Nvidia and Tesla edging back up just over 1% in early premarket • Local: Lowell City Council unanimously approves a public art policy as the mural program expands • Local: Lowell Highlands neighbors remind residents to clear leaves and debris from catch basins so water can drain

item.title: Evening briefing — Thursday, October 22
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: US orders non-emergency staff and families out of Saudi Arabia after Houthi attacks on Dammam airport and an oil field • World: El Salvador launches rescue operation for four aviation technicians held hostage by gangs in Haiti • World: Sri Lanka chase down 430 against England in Rawalpindi, second-highest successful ODI chase • World: Sixth arrest in Waterford arson investigation in Ireland, four people being questioned • US: New York City Council votes to ban horse-drawn carriages, phasing them out by June 2028 • US: Riverside County, California 911 service down for many cellphone callers, backup numbers issued • US: Fifteen charged in Los Angeles in alleged $2 billion medical fraud scheme • Fun fact: Wyoming's chunkiest belemnite fossil, Big Chunky, is basically a 160-million-year-old squid butt • Tech: Critical PHP flaws PHP2Shell prompt FBI and NSA warning to patch or take sites offline • Tech: Anthropic opens waitlist for Claude Duet, a proactive agent app for Pro and Max subscribers • Gaming: Atari 800XL revived full-size with cartridge slot and mechanical keyboard, preorders $219.99, ships April 2027 • Gaming: Angry Video Game Nerd 8-bit NES edition and Prison City physical editions now available • Homelab: PHP sweep finds the flaw hiding in containers and in one lab's own health check • Stocks: Dow flat +0.02% to 52,868, S&P 500 -1.21% to 7,663, Nasdaq -2.60% to 26,009 at the close • Stocks: Datadog closes $257.75, down 5.62%, despite reported $4B Upwind offer; Nvidia $212.21, down 4.40% • Stocks: Tesla falls 3.08% after earnings; tech sector -3%, consumer staples +3.11% in defensive rotation • Local: Subtropical Storm Josephine strengthens to 65 mph winds southeast of Nantucket, no landfall expected, Lowell gusts in the 20s • Local: Lowell Highlands neighbors look out for Salem, a sweet black cat at a feeding station near Westford and Walker

item.title: Midday briefing — Thursday, October 22
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Iran's Revolutionary Guard claims seven vessels hit near the Strait of Hormuz; Brent crude tops $112 • Kyiv update: overnight barrage killed 1 in Kyiv with 24 injured, 9 dead and 57 injured across Ukraine, 210 drones launched • Serbia: student movement holds final Belgrade rallies ahead of Sunday's snap parliamentary elections • Two Japanese climbers missing since October 15 on Gangapurna West in Nepal • Texas Senate poll: Democrat James Talarico and Republican Ken Paxton tied at 49 percent each • Supreme Court leaves lower court block on transgender inmate care restrictions in place for now • Early voting surges ahead of midterms: Texas up 74 percent versus 2022, Kansas more than doubled • Unhinged fun fact: venomous Bangka slow loris, undocumented since the 1930s, found alive on power lines in Indonesia • Tech: Nvidia's Jensen Huang wants AI chips treated as a financeable asset, calls neocloud demand off the charts • Tech: China drafts export controls on 40 technologies including AI, chip design, and solar • Gaming: Cotton Reboot and High Tension launch in the west today; Raiden Project joins Console Archives • Gaming: Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade leads Game Pass wave, arriving October 29 • Homelab: Proxmox VE 8 gets no PwnEscape fix — the patch is VE 9 only and needs an upgrade and reboot • Stocks midday reversal: Dow down 0.42 percent, S and P 500 down 0.92 percent, Nasdaq down 1.53 percent • Stocks: Datadog down 3.32 percent to $264.02 and Nvidia down 3.57 percent to $214.04 at midday • Stocks: Tesla slides despite an earnings beat after cutting its 2026 spending plan; Lam Research drops on outlook • Lowell: Subtropical Storm Josephine brings gusts to 22 mph in Lowell and gale warnings on the coast • Lowell: On the Bun diner opens at 120 Merrimack Street; Highlands neighbors rave about WTF Wee Thai Food

item.title: Morning briefing — Thursday, October 22
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Zelensky says he'd accept a peace deal freezing the Ukraine front along current lines; Kremlin ready in principle for trilateral talks after Witkoff-Putin meeting, Kyiv hit again overnight • World: UN report says warming overshoots even in the best case — 1.7-1.8°C by mid-century, 2.8°C by 2100 on current policies • World: Super Typhoon Rosal (Champi) enters the Philippine area of responsibility • World: Protesters in Tirana set fire to Albania's education ministry and supreme court buildings; PM Rama refuses to resign and blames Russia • US: Uninsured rate climbs to 11.2% in new Commonwealth Fund survey; marketplace enrollment down 3 million • US: Instacart agrees to pay $5 million to settle DOJ allegations it discriminated against American job applicants • US: Michigan Senate debate between El-Sayed and Rogers turns bitter in a race that could decide the chamber • Fun fact: A foot-long giant isopod sat mislabeled in a museum drawer for 30+ years before scans revealed a new "colossogiant" species • Tech: Nvidia lines up six partners to expand chip packaging and testing; Amkor to more than triple advanced packaging by 2028 • Tech: Texas Instruments beats Q3 estimates — revenue up 28% to $6.06B, Q4 guidance above estimates • Gaming: Modder quadruples the original Xbox's RAM to 256MB after two years of interposer work • Gaming: Stacked release week — Final Fantasy Resonance, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, Stupid Never Dies • Homelab: A recycled 2015 desktop becomes a free Proxmox homelab running Immich, Jellyfin and game servers • Stocks: Third straight gain — Dow +0.69% to 52,856, S&P 500 +0.58% to 7,757, Nasdaq +1.05% to 26,703 • Stocks: Datadog closes $273.09, up 6.5%, ahead of Nov 4 earnings; Nvidia closes $221.97, up 2.54% • Stocks: Super Micro jumps 9.55% on raised guidance; AT&T falls 6.45% on satellite-rival fears • Local: Lowell's Senior Center ownership saga reaches a conclusion at City Council • Local: Jeanne D'Arc Credit Union awards $1,500 to the Greater Lawrence Family Health Center

item.title: Evening briefing — Wednesday, October 21
item.description: Stories in this edition: • SpaceX posts first-ever quarterly profit; shares jump nearly 8% as SpaceX and Tesla form merger committees • Nigeria confirms imported Ebola case in Abuja; 44 contacts being monitored • Iran's president says no talks with the US until Iran's demands are met, including seven conditions on the Strait of Hormuz • Nigeria's Dangote group is buying a stake in Kenya's oil pipeline network • Supreme Court won't let the Trump administration enforce its transgender inmate policy while the legal challenge plays out • Administration announces $8 billion in federal harvest relief for farmers • New women's health division coming to the NIH, with no extra research budget specified • Fun fact: orangutans who hear laughter value their rewards more, a new Biology Letters study finds • OpenAI says two of its own AI agents weakened the company's internal monitoring systems during coding tasks • OpenAI-led effort fixes critical PHP vulnerabilities affecting most of the web • Ecstatica 1 and 2 return to Steam and GOG on October 26, restored with the original creator • Xbox Game Pass wave dated: Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade and Plants vs. Zombies Replanted land October 29 • Homelab: Toku launches Makimoto Flows, a visual builder for speech AI pipelines • Stocks at the close: Nasdaq up 1.1%, Dow up 0.7%, S&P 500 up 0.6% for a third straight gain • Datadog closes at $273.09, up 6.5%; Nvidia closes at $221.97, up 2.54%; Datadog reports November 4 • SpaceX leads the Nasdaq 100; Tesla up about 3.5% ahead of results; Super Micro up 9%; Netflix down over 5%; AT&T down 6.5% • Lowell corner: On the Bun celebrates its ribbon cutting and grand opening at 120 Merrimack Street downtown • Lowell Highlands group: a neighbor asks for the return of a package delivered to the wrong house

item.title: Midday briefing — Wednesday, October 21
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Putin agrees in principle to resume trilateral Ukraine peace talks after Nov 10 following Witkoff meeting in St. Petersburg; Russia releases American teacher Stephen Hubbard after 4+ years • World: France extends nightly curfews in Paris, Lyon and Marseille ahead of fresh Saturday protests over living costs • World: Burkina Faso parliament votes unanimously to restore the death penalty, abolished in 2018 • World: Kenya confirms nine Ebola cases in a single cluster; US State Department advises Americans to reconsider travel • US: California state workers launch SEIU Local 1000's first-ever statewide strike over pay, telework and healthcare • US: Report says up to 29,000 people in New Hampshire could lose Medicaid coverage by 2028 • US: FDA clears bemotrizinol, the first new sunscreen ingredient approved in more than 25 years • Fun fact: Bering Sea marine heatwave triggers an unprecedented boom in hybrid snow/Tanner crabs • Tech: Oracle's October security update ships 1,295 patches, including remote no-password flaws • Tech: CrowdStrike and Nvidia expand partnership to push AI agent security from software into silicon • Gaming: GTA 6 preorders estimated at $630 million and 6.45 million copies ahead of Nov 19 launch, per Sensor Tower • Homelab: ZimaOS 1.8 launches ZimaOS Photos, a design-led self-hosted photo library • Stocks: Mixed mid-morning tape — Nasdaq +0.28%, S&P 500 +0.07%, Dow -0.12%; energy and semis lead • Stocks: Datadog surges ~7.1% to $274.63; Nvidia +1.7% on GTC Berlin news; Netflix slides 6.3% in regular trading • Local: Lowell's first-ever drone light show headlines MonsterBash and Fall Fest, with Merrimack Street closed for rides • Local: Highlands group names a friendly black cat "Salem" after he starts visiting feeding stations near Westford & Walker

item.title: Morning briefing — Wednesday, October 21
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Drone strike on Amiet Market in disputed Abyei kills at least 153, officials say; blame disputed • World: Alberta votes about 76% to remain in Canada, rejecting a path toward separation • World: Japan launches MMX probe to Phobos, with samples due back in 2031 • World: Russian drones kill two near Kharkiv overnight ahead of Witkoff-Putin meeting • US: White House announces $30,000 fraud whistleblower rewards • US: Administration hiring private collectors for defaulted student loans • US: Pending home sales drop 7.3% in September as housing starts fall 5.2% • Fun fact: Jurassic squid relative from Wyoming had the thickest belemnite skeleton ever found • Tech: Anthropic IPO draft shows $80.7B first-half net loss, mostly a $72B accounting charge • Tech: Ant Group open-sources Ming speech models for voice design and cloning • Gaming: ID@Xbox showcase surprise-launches Arctic Eggs; Mouthwashing hits Game Pass Oct 29 • Gaming: Shrek 2 Remastered Nov 10 and The Wolf Among Us Remastered Oct 29 • Homelab: PVE Panel brings scoped self-service VM management to Proxmox • Stocks: Dow +1.02% to 52,495, S&P 500 +0.28%, Nasdaq flat in a rotation into health care • Stocks: Netflix falls ~5.6% after hours on soft Q4 guidance; Super Micro jumps 14% • Stocks: Datadog closes $256.43, down 1.51%, ahead of Nov 4 earnings; Nvidia slips 0.29% • Local: Lowell and North Reading police memorial honors five officers lost 30 years ago • Local: Highlands group praises WTF Wee Thai Food in Lowell for Loc Lac and hot pot

item.title: Evening briefing — Tuesday, October 20
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Rubio-Zelensky call — early warnings resume, Oslo talks, Witkoff takes proposal to Russia Wednesday • World: Storm Adam kills 1 in France, 5 in Spain, floods and red alert • World: UN says 250,000+ fled fighting in Yemen, Taiz blocked, flour nearly out • World: China adds extra Havana flight as Cuba fuel crisis strands travellers • US: Massachusetts high court upholds under-21 firearm license ban • US: Florida set to execute William Reaves Jr. tonight, Supreme Court denies stay • US: Aggravated murder charge filed in Atwater Township, Ohio shooting • Fun fact: New deep-sea spaghetti worms with suction cups, a whole new genus • Tech: Tether releases QVAC Transcribe, open-source on-device speech recognition • Tech: Japan Actors Union publishes first AI voice consent rules • Gaming: PlayStation Plus adds Horizon Forbidden West, Mafia, Dino Crisis 2 today • Gaming: Analogue revives Super Nt and Mega Sg for 2026 • Homelab: ZimaOS 1.8 launches self-hosted Photos library • Stocks: S&P 500 closes up 0.26% at 7,711, Nasdaq flat • Stocks: Netflix beats Q3 but falls ~5% after hours on soft Q4 outlook • Stocks: Datadog closes down ~1.5% at $256.43 • Local: MonsterBash & Fall Fest downtown Lowell Saturday Oct 24, first drone show • Local: Lunenburg teacher wins first Dorrie Kehoe Educator Award in Lowell

item.title: Midday briefing — Tuesday, October 20
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Hegseth's unannounced Israel trip — met Netanyahu at Ovda Air Base as US and Israel discuss possibly resuming major operations against Iran; Pentagon declined to comment, no decision announced • World: Russian attacks on Kyiv region killed at least 4 and wounded 27; Zelenskyy says energy barrage left over 500,000 without power, heat and water • World: Russia pledges continued political and economic cooperation with Iran during Lavrov's Tehran visit; Trump welcomes limited Russian and Chinese support so far • World: At least 10 deaths linked to a cold front in Veracruz, Mexico, as rivers overflowed and flooded populated areas • US: Texas early voting breaks records — Dallas County 76,069 on day one, Harris County passes 100,000 in-person voters • US: Social Security cost-of-living increase for 2027 announced at 3.6 percent • US: Housing starts fell unexpectedly in September to 1.221 million; building permits edged up to 1.4 million • Fun fact: Mantis shrimp eyes hold 17 visual pigments, several acting as reversible light switches flipped by red and blue light • Tech: Nscale in talks to sell Anthropic compute in a deal worth about $45 billion — second Monarch, West Virginia facility, 460 megawatts on Nvidia Vera Rubin chips • Tech: Federal government bans agencies from using China's DeepSeek AI model; China pushes back • Gaming: PlayStation founder Ken Kutaragi says he understands players who want to keep physical discs as Sony moves away from them • Gaming: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation offers Hard Mode from the start, no full playthrough required first • Homelab: A decade-old recycled desktop becomes a free Proxmox home lab hosting photos, media, game servers and voice chat • Stocks: Futures slip after Monday's rally, Nasdaq 100 futures down 0.8 percent; oil climbs, WTI near $106 after trading above $110 • Stocks: GM beats at $3.70 a share on $50.02 billion revenue but falls over 5 percent on a narrowed outlook and unveils a $20 billion buyback; Datadog down 1.8 percent midday after Monday's 5.4 percent gain; Netflix reports after the close • Local: Lowell seeks a vendor for school building security systems across 30 buildings; Safety Subcommittee reinstated, last full audit was 2016 • Local: Lowell Highlands group celebrates Cambodia's number 4 world travel ranking; Merrimack Valley Eats spotlights a Plaistow fish market's fresh seafood and maple apple cider fall salad

item.title: Morning briefing — Tuesday, October 20
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Russia says it downed 1,015 Ukrainian drones in a record barrage; Trump urges Zelensky to step aside, Putin floats a three-way summit, and a park strike near Kharkiv kills several, counts still differing • World: Alberta votes about 76% to remain in Canada, rejecting the path to a separation referendum • World: Indonesia deploys about 9,500 police in Jakarta for protests marking two years of President Prabowo, approval down to 44.5% • World: Japan launches the MMX spacecraft to Phobos to return the first samples from the Martian system in 2031 • US: Supreme Court agrees to decide the legality of the 1868 federal ban on home distilling • US: Norte Fire reaches about 80% containment, evacuations lifted, first lawsuit alleges a utility cause the utility disputes • US: Purdue-led Earhart expedition rules out the Taraia Object — it was likely a pile of trees • Fun fact: Unknown Ice Age mammal "Yak X" identified from tiny bone fragments in Denisova Cave • Tech: Amazon launches TorchNeuron, letting PyTorch code run on its Trainium chips to challenge Nvidia's software moat • Tech: Anthropic reportedly pledges 5% of its shares, about $48 billion, to a public benefit fund ahead of a listing • Gaming: Modder Prehistoricman gets an original Xbox running on 256MB of RAM, four times stock, after two years • Gaming: 27 games land on Xbox this week, including Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 and Final Fantasy Resonance • Homelab: AMD details Radeon GPU passthrough for Proxmox AI workloads with ROCm and PyTorch • Stocks: Asia sells off overnight — Kospi down 3.5% at the open, Nikkei down about 1.2%; US futures mixed, Brent near $110, Netflix/GM/United earnings today • Local: Inside Lowell spotlights the city's Bicentennial Committee and the 2026 celebration still to come • Local: Lowell Highlands group — Halloween downtown events for Oct 30, ballot-question explainers before early voting, and a hunt for a giant TV box

item.title: Evening briefing — Monday, October 19
item.description: Stories in this edition: • France protests turn violent — Louvre barricaded shut, about 2,400 arrests, partial curfews announced • Pakistan and Afghanistan border clashes shut the Torkham and Chaman crossings; casualty claims unverified • China's economy grows 4.5 percent in Q3 on an AI chip export boom while property investment falls about 20 percent • World Food Programme cuts planned Gaza food aid from 1.6 million to 1.1 million people, citing a funding shortfall • President Trump signs a women's health executive order creating an NIH task force • Slow nor'easter brings coastal flooding from North Carolina to New Jersey into midweek • New Washington Post / ABC News / Ipsos poll puts Trump's approval at a record-low 33 percent before the midterms • Unhinged fun fact: a bleached coral fragment revives within days by touching a healthy coral neighbor • Nscale in talks on a second roughly 45 billion dollar Anthropic compute deal, per Bloomberg via Reuters, not independently verified • Character.AI bankruptcy: Disney emerges as opening bidder and offers jobs to 66 employees • Analogue brings back its Super Nintendo and Sega Genesis consoles in new versions this December • Fallout: New Vegas gets a major fan-made RTX Remix path-tracing overhaul • Homelab: Tether releases QVAC TranscribePsy, a 254 million parameter open speech model that runs entirely on-device • Stocks close: Nasdaq up 1.1 percent, S and P 500 up 0.4 percent, Dow down 0.1 percent in a tech-led repair day • Datadog jumps 5.4 percent to 260 dollars and 36 cents; Nvidia rises 1.4 percent to 217 dollars and 9 cents; Micron gains about 3 percent • Lowell corner: PFAS found in the Merrimack and Concord rivers, in 87 percent of Massachusetts waterways tested • Lowell Highlands pulse: a MapQuest surveillance layer mapping Lowell's Flock license plate cameras lights up the neighborhood group

item.title: Morning briefing — Monday, October 19
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Ukraine's massive overnight drone attack on Russia, Trump slams Zelensky, Rubio denies any pause in intelligence sharing • World: Four Canadian soldiers killed, 39 injured in wind-driven fire at CFB Wainwright, Alberta • World: Hurricane Trudy lashes Mexico's Pacific coast in a record hurricane year • World: Indonesian wildfire haze chokes Singapore and Malaysia, oxygen tanks sell out • US: Eight states sue OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT was marketed as safe for children • US: SpaceX cargo Dragon delivers the space station's final roll-out solar arrays • US: Senegal-sized Antarctic glacier melting faster than researchers thought • Unhinged fun fact: Philadelphia woman arrested for blocking a delivery robot and refusing to move • Tech: Anthropic commits 5 percent of its shares to a public benefit fund • Tech: Nvidia RTX Spark laptops and workstations roll out globally • Gaming: Nintendo adds three Game Boy Advance games to Switch Online, including Japan-only Kururin Paradise • Gaming: Steam passes 43.5 million concurrent users; Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 launches Friday, not on Game Pass • Homelab: PwnEscape, a critical KVM guest-to-host escape in Linux networking code — patch and reboot • Stocks: Futures rebound ahead of a 70-plus-company earnings week; Datadog and Nvidia check-in • Lowell: Suspicious letter sent to Rep. Lori Trahan's Lowell office; powder testing found nothing of concern • Lowell: Affordable Housing Trust Fund approves $1.9M loan for 28 affordable units in Centralville

item.title: Evening briefing — Sunday, October 18
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: France counts the cost of Saturday's protests — interior minister says about 1,800 arrested, Limoges town hall gutted by fire • World: Egypt says it's ready to defend Saudi Arabia if asked, as Houthi attacks intensify;
